does_not_do: Its README warns not to use it for 2025 and later US tax reporting until per-wallet application is supported (issue 135). It handles crypto only.
focus_reason: The lot accounting matches the need, but the project's own notice rules out current US tax years and there has been no release since 2025-02-15.
measured_against: Need: compute tax lots, cost basis and realised gains from transaction records, to check against IRS Publications 550 and 551.
tests_ci: A tests/ directory; CI runs unit tests on Unix and Windows, static analysis and CodeQL.
what_it_is: A crypto tax calculator for several countries: it computes lots, gains and losses from input spreadsheets and writes reports, including a Form 8949-style report for the US.
